name: agent-radar
description: An animation-studio team of your subagents, drawn as detailed outlined chibi pixel art: each agent is a studio staffer at a desk (director Kaito in an orange beret, location scout Pip, sound engineer Rachael, storyboard artist Mira, producer Vance, QC editor Ren, animator Bolt, archivist Sora and more; original characters, each with a signature look and prop; a second agent of one role wears a sibling's colors); while /gauntlet runs, the office becomes a colosseum (a waving crowd, a sand ring) with its competitors as eight different gladiators sparring in pairs (murmillo, retiarius, thraex and more), its judges eight robed, bewigged judges gavelling, writing and lifting scorecards, and the Lead an emperor; it turns on with the first gauntlet agent and back to the studio after the gauntlet's closing step, in a night-time studio with a neon STUDIO sign, a window on the city and a token board; finished agents rest in the break room with a + mark, stuck ones show an x; animated in the terminal and the desktop. Portrait cards with status, model, effort, tokens and a context gauge, plus details per subagent: its last calls, calls by tool, files edited and read, tokens by kind, start and end times, and its answer. The other sessions on this machine are storeys of one pixel office building under a neon-sign roof: each a band of lit windows, one per person at work (orange for the Lead, red and blinking when someone waits on you), dark when idle, with its name and status beside it; sessions idle for 2 h are hidden, and at most 6 floors show (/radar idle <hours>, /radar floors <n>, /radar sessions all|recent); open one (its button or /radar expand <n>) for its whole office and cards. A band above the prompt for the skills in use and the other sessions at work. A local router that picks each subagent's model (Sonnet or Opus only, never Haiku or Fable) and effort from its task, and raises a delegate role tagged hard or deep to Opus (it never lowers one). Sends nothing out; on disk it keeps counts, view settings and one small status file per session in ~/.claude/agent-radar/live (labels, status, model, times, tokens, calls with a short argument and edited file names; no prompt, thinking or answer).
